Since the early days of quantum physics, some scientists have believed that there’s a link between quantum mechanics and consciousness. While most researchers don’t think this idea holds water, a few have published papers about how phosphate molecules in the brain could link consciousness to quantum physics. Let’s take a look.

Paper: https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11993700/
